title: One raw capture
description: One message as received: who it came from, where, when, and its bytes unchanged.

source.description: The source identity (the subscription profile's name, or the device path's own).

payload_b64.description: The payload bytes exactly as received, base64.

retained.description: The broker's retained copy, delivered at subscribe: stored, flagged, never treated as live.

received_at.description: The receiver's clock at arrival, UTC, milliseconds. Not the observation time a payload may carry.
